about_the_game:
Lose Yourself in Memory

Overwhelmed by what the future has in store, you stumble into a world where you can experience unexplained nostalgia and memories forever. This is a place where memories live on, and time itself seems broken. But what feels like comfort soon reveals its trap: others are stranded here too, bound by their pasts. To free them — and yourself — you must gather the fragments of their lives, unlock their stories, and uncover the truth behind this place that refuses to let you go.

All That Time is a surreal narrative adventure where you journey through strange, beautiful, and unsettling spaces — part puzzle, part memory, part dream. Relive what was, confront what lingers, and guide the lost toward release.

Game Features

  • Explore haunting, dreamlike worlds — Walk through familiar and nostalgic-like areas that make you keep looking around.

  • Uncover hidden stories — Collect objects tied to the lives of those who are also trapped here, piecing together their histories to set them free.

  • Solve puzzles woven into memory — Unlock pathways and secrets by solving atmospheric challenges.

  • Experience shifting moods and atmospheres — From cozy childhood echoes to unsettling liminal spaces, each area carries its own emotional weight.

  • Meet others lost in time — Encounter characters caught in the faculty and decide how you can free them.

  • Immerse yourself in sound and silence — A layered, dreamlike soundtrack pulls you deeper into memory, while moments of stillness sharpen the weight of discovery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: All That Time is a first-person nostalgic adventure where you wander surreal spaces, relive childhood dreams and memories, solve hidden mysteries, and search for your own escape while freeing those who remain trapped.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
